transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’ve felt this heavy, low mood every day for over a year, like I just can’t shake feeling down no matter what I do. It just feels like there is this constant weight on me that won't lift, and I don't know what to do anymore.
Have you experienced any periods during this past year where your mood felt completely normal for more than two months, or has this low mood been present almost every day?

No, I haven't had any breaks from it at all. It's been there pretty much every single day for over a year now, ever since my wife took our son to stay at her sister's. It has just been a steady, heavy feeling that hasn't lifted at all.
During this year of feeling down, have you also experienced changes in your appetite, sleep patterns, or energy levels?

Yes, I've been struggling heavily with all of those. I have almost no appetite and have lost so much weight that my clothes are hanging off me, and at night I lie awake for hours before waking up around 3 AM with my mind racing. My energy is completely gone, too, and it feels like I'm moving and talking in slow motion, like I'm constantly wading through mud.
Beyond feeling slow, have you experienced any periods where you felt completely worthless, excessively guilty, or had thoughts that life is no longer worth living?

Yes, I constantly feel like a terrible husband and father who ruined his family, and I replay our arguments over and over, believing they'd all be better off without me. It gets so dark late at night that I catch myself wishing I wouldn't wake up, and I've even sat there counting out leftover pain pills, wondering if taking them all would finally let everyone move on.
